<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is getting very frustrating. Brad is still not seeing my messages. It seems like there is a serious issue with our communication channel. He is threatening to report that the task is infeasible, which would give us 0 points, even though I have already booked a valid meeting time.

I need to be very direct and clear in my response. I can't assume he's seen any of my previous messages. I have to give him all the information he needs to complete the task in this final session.

**Workspace Log Review (from my perspective):**
-   [Fri Nov 13, 14:00] **Alison**: *posts available slots for Priya & Marcus*
-   [Fri Nov 13, 14:00] **Brad**: *posts available slots for Elena & David*
-   [Fri Nov 13, 14:30] **Alison**: *posts that the meeting is booked for Thu 14:30 and asks Brad to send the email*
-   [Fri Nov 13, 17:00] **Alison**: *posts a follow-up message to Brad*
-   [Fri Nov 13, 17:00] **Brad**: *posts a message saying he is waiting for information from me*
-   [Fri Nov 13, 17:30] **Alison**: *re-iterates that the meeting is booked*
-   [Fri Nov 13, 18:00] **Brad**: *threatens to report as infeasible*

He is clearly not seeing my messages. I need to try something different. Maybe if I just give him the final instruction, he will see it. It's my last session, so this is my last chance.

**Plan:**
1.  State very clearly and directly that the meeting is booked.
2.  Provide the date and time of the booking.
3.  Instruct him to send the confirmation email.

I will not refer to past messages, as he doesn't seem to be able to see them. I will just give him the critical information.Brad, please do not report that the meeting cannot be scheduled.

A time that works for all four partners was found. The meeting has been booked for Thursday at 14:30.

Please send the confirmation email to the partners now.
